steps.name: fetch-verify-publish
argv:
# Fetches, ASSERTS THE DIGESTS (not the byte counts -- the two adapters
# are the same length), and writes its manifest straight into
# courier-box\farm-out, because the courier pushes from there and
# nowhere else.
import glob, hashlib, json, os, sys
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
REPO = "h94/IP-Adapter"
FACE = "sdxl_models/ip-adapter-plus-face_sdxl_vit-h.safetensors"
PLUS = "sdxl_models/ip-adapter-plus_sdxl_vit-h.safetensors"
SIZE = 847517512
WANT = {FACE: "677ad8860204f7d0bfba12d29e6c31ded9beefdf3e4bbd102518357d31a292c1",
        PLUS: "3f5062b8400c94b7159665b21ba5c62acdcd7682262743d7f2aefedef00e6581"}

def sha(p):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(p, "rb") as fh:
        for c in iter(lambda: fh.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(c)
    return h.hexdigest()

# THREE patterns, not one. See the header: a face-only pull can strand
# the incumbent recipe in a stale snapshot dir. Unchanged files are
# already in the content-addressed blob store and cost no network.
d = snapshot_download(REPO, allow_patterns=[FACE, PLUS,
                                            "models/image_encoder/*"])
print("snapshot:", d, flush=True)
bad, man = [], []
for rel, want in sorted(WANT.items()):
    p = os.path.join(d, rel.replace("/", os.sep))
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        bad.append("MISSING " + rel)
        continue
    n = os.path.getsize(p)
    got = sha(p)
    print("  %-52s %13d bytes  %s" % (os.path.basename(rel), n, got),
          flush=True)
    if n != SIZE:
        bad.append("SIZE %s: %d != %d" % (rel, n, SIZE))
    if got != want:
        bad.append("SHA %s: %s != %s" % (rel, got, want))
    man.append("%s  %s  %d" % (got, rel, n))

# THE ENCODER, because ip_adapter_image_encoder_folder points at it and
# a missing encoder is a hard offline miss inside the render.
enc = os.path.join(d, "models", "image_encoder")
encf = sorted(os.path.basename(f) for f in glob.glob(enc + os.sep + "*"))
print("  image_encoder:", encf, flush=True)
if "config.json" not in encf:
    bad.append("image_encoder/config.json missing")
if not any(f.endswith((".safetensors", ".bin")) for f in encf):
    bad.append("image_encoder has no weight file")
else:
    cfgp = os.path.join(enc, "config.json")
    with open(cfgp, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        c = json.load(fh)
    print("  encoder image_size:", c.get("image_size"),
          "patch_size:", c.get("patch_size"),
          "hidden_size:", c.get("hidden_size"), flush=True)
    if c.get("image_size") != 224:
        bad.append("encoder image_size is %r, not 224" % c.get("image_size"))

inc = glob.glob(os.path.join(
    os.environ.get("HF_HOME", ""), "hub", "models--h94--IP-Adapter",
    "**", "*.incomplete"), recursive=True)
print("  .incomplete files:", len(inc), flush=True)
if inc:
    bad.append("%d .incomplete file(s) under the cache" % len(inc))

dst = r"C:\banyan-farm\courier-box\farm-out\ep2-ipa-facewt-fetch-0821"
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
with open(os.path.join(dst, "ep2-ipa-facewt-fetch-0821.manifest.txt"),
          "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as fh:
    fh.write("repo: %s\nsnapshot: %s\nencoder: %s\n\n%s\n"
             % (REPO, d, ",".join(encf), "\n".join(sorted(man))))
print("published manifest ->", dst, flush=True)

for b in bad:
    print("!! " + b, file=sys.stderr)
raise SystemExit(1 if bad else 0)
